topic: Both want the one sunny spot by the window; they learn to share it.

episode.title: Mishi & Bruno: One Sunny Spot

shots.narration: One sunny spot, two best friends—who gets the warmth?
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, warm 3D family animation. A cosy colourful living room has one small oval of sunshine beside a tall window. Mishi is a fluffy grey kitten with green eyes, a pink nose and a red ear bow. Bruno is a chubby golden-brown puppy with floppy ears, a black nose and a blue collar with a bone-s
shots.action: Mishi and Bruno reach a front paw toward the same sunny oval.
shots.mood: Golden light, rounded furniture, wide curious eyes.

shots.narration: Bruno claims it with one enormous puppy flop.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, cosy 3D living room, small sunny oval on a soft peach rug beside the window, no text.
shots.action: Bruno flops across the whole sunny oval beside Mishi.
shots.mood: Soft golden fur, floppy ears spread wide, playful warmth.

shots.narration: [chuckles] But where can Mishi put her chilly paws?
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, peach rug beside the window, Bruno filling the sunny oval, Mishi just beyond its edge, no text.
shots.action: Mishi stretches one paw toward a tiny uncovered sliver of sunshine.
shots.mood: Comically tiny sunlit sliver, hopeful green eyes, gentle disappointment.

shots.narration: Bruno notices his friend sitting outside the sunshine.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, warm 3D living room, Bruno in the sunny oval and Mishi sitting on the shaded rug, no text.
shots.action: Bruno turns his head toward Mishi's shaded paws.
shots.mood: Soft concerned eyes, relaxed ears, warm afternoon colours.

shots.narration: His big heart makes room—for Mishi alone.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, peach rug with one sunny oval beside the window, no text.
shots.action: Bruno scoots completely out of the sunshine.
shots.mood: Generous puppy smile, inviting empty patch of golden light.

shots.narration: [sighs] Now Mishi's warm, but Bruno isn't.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, sunny oval on the peach rug, Bruno sitting just outside its edge, no text.
shots.action: Mishi stretches across the sunny oval.
shots.mood: Contented kitten, drooping puppy ears, gentle visual contrast.

shots.narration: Mishi spots the problem: taking turns still leaves someone out.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, warm 3D living room, Mishi stretched in sunshine beside shaded Bruno, no text.
shots.action: Mishi turns her head toward Bruno.
shots.mood: Thoughtful green eyes, soft shadows, quiet affection.

shots.narration: She curls up small, leaving half the sunshine free.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, clearly defined sunny oval on a peach rug, Bruno seated at its edge, no text.
shots.action: Mishi curls into a compact ball on one side of the oval.
shots.mood: Neat fluffy kitten curl, bright empty space beside her.

shots.narration: [giggles] Bruno tries his smallest, roundest puppy curl.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, Mishi curled on half the sunny oval beside the window, no text.
shots.action: Bruno curls into the remaining half beside Mishi.
shots.mood: Squishy puppy cheeks, tucked floppy ears, cosy golden light.

shots.narration: Two little curls fit better than one big sprawl.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, both friends curled together inside the same sunny oval on the peach rug, no text.
shots.action: Mishi rests her head against Bruno's shoulder.
shots.mood: Touching fluffy cheeks, sleepy smiles, soft warm highlights.

shots.narration: The sunshine feels even nicer with a friend.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, cosy colourful living room, both friends sharing the sunlit rug beside the garden window, no text.
shots.action: Mishi and Bruno close their eyes together.
shots.mood: Peaceful smiles, touching shoulders, rich honey-coloured sunlight.

shots.narration: [excited] Sharing feels sunny; next, why won't our garden pinwheel spin?
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, both friends together in the sunny window spot, a bright motionless pinwheel visible outside in the sunny garden, no text.
shots.action: Mishi points one paw toward the garden pinwheel.
shots.mood: Curious green eyes, perked puppy ears, colourful garden promise.

episode.endHook: Next, why won't their garden pinwheel spin?
episode.description: Mishi and Bruno both want the same cosy patch of sunshine. A little kindness helps them discover that the best spot is one they can share.
